text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"A randomized trial at Ctrip found a 13% performance increase for fully remote call center workers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#6"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"The Ctrip remote work gains were attributed to fewer sick days and a quieter environment.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#6"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A later study by Bloom and co-authors found fully remote work reduced output by 10-20% for some roles, particularly those requiring high collaboration or newly hired workers.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#6"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A meta-analysis summary reports a median productivity impact of +10% for focused tasks and -4% for collaborative tasks.","cited_pids":["d658dc380b73#5"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A study found full-remote work five days a week was associated with reduced work productivity.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Promoting remote work reduced stress responses in the same study.","cited_pids":["abefd158b9c2#2"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"A field experiment found discretionary remote working of about two days per week helped mothers without harming non-mothers.","cited_pids":["ef88116f982d#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Remote work's effect on performance depends on how organizations provide autonomy, connection, and support.","cited_pids":["47cdadbd2ab4#2"]}]}
